name: Redtail Open Verifier
description: An open-source verifier for tamper-evident public records, integrity proofs, and reproducible verification workflows.

funding_needs.title: Public-interest verifier development
funding_needs.description: Funding would support development of a standalone verifier package, local/offline command-line verifier, portable verification receipts, self-hostable public verification interface, pluggable anchoring layer, expanded test vectors, public-interest documentation, external security and privacy review, and usability testing with public-interest workflows.
